text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Uwoooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Right now," right here... I will break through my limits... once again!!
(――SHATTERRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAARGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Mejiro Ardan!!
Mejiro Ardan takes the lead here!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan! She crosses the finish line in first place!
Overtaking Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross,
the young lady of the Mejiros takes the victory!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh... I won...!!
Breaking past my limits again today...!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Sheesh, they really got me, honestly.
What an absolute whirlwind she turned out to be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Miss Tamamo...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Congrats. Ya put on a good run for us.
I'll let ya have it this time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, next time won't go like this.
Be ready for it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I, too—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I won't lose.
Not to you, and not to Tama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The next time we battle,
I do not intend to yield a single step, either.
Just like today... victory shall be mine!

As I went out to welcome Mejiro Ardan back,
who had pulled off a stunning upset to a roaring crowd—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"This is all thanks to you, Trainer...
and everyone who ran with me today."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Besides... I was able to become certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross-san and Oguri Cap-san.
As long as there are countless rivals like them who dedicate their heart and soul to every contest—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This body can surpass any and all limits without bound,
and the brilliance it emits, the trail of light it can trace,
can be made infinitely dazzling...!

Even right after a monumental victory,
Mejiro Ardan's drive to improve burns fiercely...!
choice_data_list: Next, let's win the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "It's the classic royal road race to determine the strongest middle-distance runner of the spring, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Using the sensations I grasped today as fuel, I will shine even more vividly and fiercely in the Senior Year."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Taking a new step forward from here—
I look forward to your continued guidance and support.
And so, together with Mejiro Ardan, we set our sights on a new goal and marched toward the Senior Class.
And at almost the exact same time—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Mejiro Ardan!!
Crosses the finish line in first place!!
The Mejiro young lady pulls off an upset!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Amazing—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san... actually won...
against such strong opponents...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And yet... I...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...It's okay. I can become even stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—No. I must become stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So that when Chiyono O-san returns someday...
I will be worthy of being her rival...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—The Osaka Hai.
There, I will surely shine even brighter...!
